scheme_name: Distribution of Certified Seeds of Maize
other_conditions: Must be growing maize in the specified districts of Tamil Nadu (Coimbatore, Dindigul, Erode, Dharmapuri, Krishnagiri, Namakkal, Perambalur, Virudhunagar, Theni, Villupuram, Vellore, Salem, Pudukkottai, Madurai, Sivagangai, Trichy, Tirunelveli, Thoothukudi)
Preference will be given to small/marginal farmers
24% flow of benefits ensured for SC/ST farmers
20% flow of benefits ensured for women farmers or women groups
benefits_summary: 50% subsidy on certified maize seed cost, capped at ₹1,200 per quintal.
